gloss: abstract copy; extract (of an official register)

definitions.gloss: abstract copy; extract of an official register
definitions.explanation: An official document that reproduces only the portion of a register relating to one person, as opposed to a copy of the whole register. Almost always used in compounds such as {戸籍|こせき}{抄本|しょうほん}.

examples.japanese: {戸籍|こせき}{抄本|しょうほん}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: I need an abstract copy of my family register.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}で{抄本|しょうほん}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got an abstract copy at city hall.

examples.japanese: {申請|しんせい}には{戸籍|こせき}{抄本|しょうほん}を{一通|いっつう}{添|そ}えてください。
examples.english: Please attach one abstract copy of your family register to the application.

notes:
A {抄本|しょうほん} extracts only the part of an official register relating to one person, while a {謄本|とうほん} reproduces the entire register. Rarely used alone — it almost always appears in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戸籍|こせき}{抄本|しょうほん}: abstract copy of a family register (one person's section)
- {住民票|じゅうみんひょう}の{抄本|しょうほん}: abstract of a residence record
- {抄本|しょうほん}を{取|と}る: to obtain an abstract copy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {謄本|とうほん}: certified full copy — reproduces the whole register, not just one person's part
